draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.59, the 248th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 35th of 37 at CB. He went 99th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (248th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 4 passes defended in 2020, 20th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 50 career games and 19 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (9 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: interceptions 5 (98th percentile), season snap share 97.0% (97th percentile), approximate value 9 (96th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 97.0% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, above the norm.
